description: List up to 50 subdomains of a registrable domain from Certificate Transparency, DNS queries for 94 common names and the domain's MX, NS and SPF records, and, when DNS can tell, whether each listed name has an IPv4 address. Costs 2 credits.

domain.description: Domain name, such as example.com; www.example.com asks about example.com

name: subdomain_enum

certificate_logs_available.description: true when Cert Spotter answered and its names are in the answer.

certificate_logs_complete.description: Present only when certificate_logs_available is true. The server reads one page from Cert Spotter. true when that page held no certificate. false when it held some, since a later page may hold more names.

certificate_logs_reason.description: Present only when certificate_logs_available is false. It is quota_exhausted or upstream_error.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

domain.description: The registrable domain the server asked about.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before the server sends that request again. Present only when certificate_logs_reason is quota_exhausted. A cached answer shows the wait from when it was made.

subdomain_count.description: It counts the names found, up to 1000. subdomains lists at most 50.

subdomains.description: The names DNS confirms come first, then the names only certificate logs give. Each group is in byte order.

has_ipv4_address.description: true when the name has an A record, false when it has none. Absent when the server has no clear answer.

sources.description: It says how the name was found: certificate_logs, dns_wordlist or dns_records.

wildcard_dns.description: It says whether random names under the domain resolve. The value absent means they do not, present means they do, and undetermined means the test gave no clear answer.

title: Subdomain Enumeration
